evidence.title: Tokalator: token budgets and cost across 17 LLMs
evidence.text: AI coding assistants burn tokens blindly, with no visibility into context cost and no budget guardrails. I built Tokalator: real-time token budgeting, tab relevance scoring, output-quality models and caching break-even analysis across 17 LLMs. Shipped as a VS Code extension and a web platform with 500+ installs, AGPL-3.0 licensed, built with Next.js, TypeScript and MCP.

evidence.title: Tokalator paper (arXiv 2604.08290)
evidence.text: Tokalator: A Context Engineering Toolkit for AI Coding Assistants. Sole author. An open-source toolkit for token-aware context management, cost modelling and workflow optimisation, published on arXiv in April 2026.

evidence.title: Multi-agent job classification: 95% accuracy on 14K+ positions
evidence.text: Free-form job titles in several languages could not be mapped to O*NET and ESCO taxonomies at scale. I built an MCP-based multi-agent system with planner, search, extraction and evaluation agents over a shared caching layer, using LangGraph. Result: 95% accuracy on 14K+ positions, 72.5% faster classification and 41.8% fewer API calls.

evidence.title: ProjectLens: 64 hours of pricing work down to 5.5
evidence.text: Every project quote started as a fresh Excel file. With the Pricing & Revenue team I built ProjectLens, one tool that runs request intake, effort calculation, pricing, proposal, approval and follow-up end to end, wired into Microsoft Teams and Azure DevOps, with a read-only SQL console and a presentation mode that masks figures. 91% of the manual effort removed: 64 hours down to 5.5, 31 spreadsheets no longer created. The 2-hour manual baseline is a team estimate, not a measurement.

evidence.title: Metadata platform: 300M+ datapoints unified
evidence.text: A live job platform had no unified metadata layer: fragmented schemas, no lineage, analytics stuck on ad-hoc queries. I designed the metadata architecture with DataHub governance, real-time pipelines and product-analytics instrumentation on Azure Synapse and BigQuery. 300M+ datapoints unified; it became the foundation for later embedding generation, RAG retrieval and context grounding.
